verdict.rationale: Sprinto has a Developer API that uses API keys, so this axis applies to the product. However, no evidence shows those keys can be scoped, restricted to least privilege, or issued per agent. The only access detail is that the API Playground needs administrator privileges and a valid API key, which shows that keys exist, not that they can be scoped.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can issue scoped/least-privilege API credentials for an agent
